attempts.title: Anything You Want: 40 Lessons for a New Kind of Entrepreneur
attempts.byline: Englisch Ausgabe von Derek Sivers (Autor) Format: Gebundene Ausgabe
attempts.pageTitle: Anything You Want: 40 Lessons for a New Kind of Entrepreneur - Sivers, Derek - Amazon.de: Bücher
attempts.description: id="bookDescription_feature_div" class="celwidget" data-feature-name="bookDescription" data-csa-c-type="widget" data-csa-c-content-id="bookDescription" data-csa-c-slot-id="bookDescription_feature_div" data-csa-c-asin="1591848261" data-csa-c-is-in-initial-active-row="false"> You can follow the beaten path and call yourself an entrepreneur or you can blaze your own trail and really be one. When Derek Sivers started CD Baby, he wasn’t planning on building a major business. He was a successful independent musician who just wanted to sell his CDs online. When no one would help him do it, he set out on his own and built an online store from scratch. He started in 1998 by helping his friends sell their CDs. In 2000, he hired his first employee. Eight years later, he sold CD Baby for $22 million. Sivers didn’t need a business plan, and neither do you. You don’t need to think big; in fact, it’s better if you don’t. Start with what you have, care about your customers more than yourself, and run your business like you don’t need the money. Mehr lesen
